description: The six-digit sign-in code (docs/sign-in.md, supabase/config.toml otp_length). 'parse': what the code box accepts as typed: six ASCII digits, spaces between them allowed, nothing else; null otherwise. 'find': the code in text copied from somewhere else (the email's notification, its subject, the email itself), so the sign-in screen can take it from the clipboard: the one run of six digits that stands alone (not part of a longer run of digits, letters or a time like 10:30 on either side), optionally split once by a space or a dash as 123 456 or 123-456. Null when there is none, or when the text holds two different codes, since guessing could sign in with the wrong one; the same code twice is fine.

find.name: a sentence around it
find.text: Your sign-in code is 482913. It works for 10 minutes.

find.name: the same code twice
find.text: 482913 is your GoalMaker code. Your sign-in code is 482913.

find.name: a longer number is not a code
digits glued to letters are not a code
a year and a time are not codes
a phone number is not a code
